description: Cancer-specific RNA expression of a human gene in a cancer type, from the Human Protein Atlas (HPA). Coverage is restricted to genes classified as Cancer enriched, Cancer enhanced or Group enriched, with a recorded per-cancer pTPM expression value. This is not a catalog of all detected gene expression in cancer. Gene-level specificity and distribution categories are repeated across the cancer relationships for that gene.

common_properties.name: group
common_properties.description: HPA RNA cancer specificity category: Cancer enriched, Cancer enhanced or Group enriched.

common_properties.name: distribution
common_properties.description: HPA RNA cancer distribution category for the gene, such as Detected in all or Detected in some. This is gene-level information repeated across its cancer relationships.

common_properties.name: pTPM
common_properties.description: Recorded RNA expression value for this gene in the associated cancer type, from the HPA RNA cancer specific pTPM field.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources supporting this relationship; HPA contributes the value HPA.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp when the relationship was created or its properties or source support changed.

source_contributions.scope: Human genes in the HPA RNA cancer expression data with Cancer enriched, Cancer enhanced or Group enriched specificity and a non-empty per-cancer pTPM field. Only entries with corresponding Gene and Disease nodes are represented. A missing specificity score does not exclude an otherwise qualifying relationship.
source_contributions.description: HPA supplies cancer-specific expression values and gene-level RNA cancer specificity, distribution and specificity score. Each relationship represents one gene and cancer type.

properties.name: specificity_score
properties.description: HPA RNA cancer specificity score for the gene; the same gene-level value is repeated across its cancer relationships.
